system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"<USER> . Guys, can you please stop deleting all my offline music. It’s really, really annoying. We’ve always been fine, now I just don’t know."

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! I totally get how frustrating that can be. Can you let us know if this is happening to specific albums or playlists? /AI"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Remove '/AI' and add guidance on offline music deletion causes."}
